evidence.excerpt: We introduce LMBuild, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents on generating buildable and functional structures.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: To support reproducible evaluation, we provide a unified framework consisting of: (1) an interactive environment in which agents can use tools to retrieve, create, and place components to construct objects; (2) a curated benchmark that repurposes established CAD datasets and augments them with knowledge from Wikipedia; and (3) a evaluation framework covering structural soundness, functional affordance, design quality, and physical realization.
